headline: Weathered Expanse Toll Mounts; Kuura Strand Wholly Colonial
war_summary: Since our last edition, the ledger at Weathered Expanse has turned against the Colonials: they now hold four of nine posts against two Warden and three in ruin, after forty-six flag actions made it the war's busiest ground in the past day. The hourly toll there eases from its peak, yet fresh exchanges were logged minutes before this dispatch. Kuura Strand, by contrast, has settled — all six posts fly Colonial colors, though the shore's day toll topped five thousand and skirmishing lingered past 0140 hours. Nevish Line holds at five Warden, three Colonial, with more than seven thousand casualties in a day and fighting at Tomb Father and Princefal as lately as two o'clock. Linn Mercy's great blaze about Outwich Ranch has burned down; no flag has moved there since mid-morning, though the day's count runs heavy. Marban Hollow remains deadlocked, four Warden to three Colonial, Checkpoint Bua again the chief prize. Stlican Shelf logged fresh action within two hours of this filing, Breaker Town its liveliest post, while Pari Peak traded posts through the evening before falling quiet. Callahans Passage, without a single flag event, still logged nearly seven thousand casualties. This is the war's 682nd day; thirty-four victory towns are required, and no victor is declared.
